title: Leaderboards
summary: The Leaderboard tab: Weekly / World / Country boards with the pinned player row and jump pill.
description: LeaderboardViews draws the tab bodies inside the page shell (header, tab strip, weekly countdown): the World and Country top lists and the player's weekly group, all from the offline social world.
gaps: LeaderboardViews calls SocialFlows (events-engine), so taking the leaderboard takes the events engine and, through EventsDirector, the game loop. Its page frame (LeaderboardPageShell) is in social-ui.
